[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Contribution report — Elizabeth Wong CNY→USD reconciliations, PDF CJK/multibyte defect, SOP authoring + merge
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1835
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1836
  
  Details:
  Contribution report for Gary Teh's time across this working thread.
  
  SCOPE OF WORK (this report):
  1. Directed and reviewed the conversion and filing of Elizabeth Wong's DeepSeek invoices from CNY to USD — three invoices (CNY 300 / 200 / 100) converted at each invoice's own ECB reference rate (6.6616 / 6.6713 / 6.6707) to USD 45.03 / 29.98 / 14.99 = 90.00 TDG, filed as separate USD contributions summing exactly to the consolidated total with no rounding residual.
  
  2. Caught a real rendering defect that had already passed one presentation: Chinese characters in the generated PDF were being emitted as literal 'I' runs, not displayed characters. Root cause: the PDF generator registered only base-14 Type1 Helvetica with WinAnsiEncoding — a 256-glyph Latin codepage with no CJK mapping — and reportlab substitutes silently rather than raising. Diagnosed the font constraint that the obvious fix would have hit (Noto Sans CJK ships PostScript outlines and cannot be embedded by reportlab's TTFont; WenQuanYi Micro Hei can), and drove the fix to per-run font routing so CJK glyphs embed while Latin typography survives. Verified by extracting text back out of the rendered PDF and asserting all 10 CJK strings round-trip, the old corruption signature is absent, no markup leaks, and all 11 numeric figures are intact.
  
  3. Established the standing standard so the defect cannot recur silently — authored sops/PDF_GENERATION_SOP.md in agentic_ai_context and indexed it in WORKSPACE_CONTEXT.md §3a and PROJECT_INDEX.md. The SOP records the root cause, the font trap, the per-run routing requirement, and a mandatory extract-and-assert verification gate on the grounds that visual inspection is insufficient — 'I' runs read as column alignment and a reviewer who cannot read the script sees nothing wrong.
  
  4. Reviewed and authorised merging both context PRs (squash-merged as f5badab and 4bee267), making the standard live on main rather than parked in a PR.
  
  5. Consolidated Elizabeth Wong's two China-market-expansion transfers into a single contribution: CNY 500.00 on 2026-11-13 and CNY 5,000.00 on 2026-07-15, each converted at its own-date ECB rate (6.6683 / 6.7743) to USD 74.98 + USD 738.08 = USD 813.06. Supplied the decisive missing input — confirming both transfers were in Chinese yuan — which is what unblocked the filing after OCR could not resolve the currency glyph on the larger transfer. Directed the single-contribution framing while accepting separate ledger rows to avoid re-filing the already-recorded 500.00 leg.
  
  IGNORED FROM THIS REPORT (already filed separately, listed to prevent double-counting):
  - 10 minutes — compiling the shipping request to Kirsten Ritschel (16.67 TDG)
  - 30 minutes — reviewing the AGROVERSE Contrato Social Bicolunado and responding to Flow Vista (50.00 TDG)
  
  TIME BASIS AND CAVEAT:
  The 90 minutes recorded here is an ESTIMATE of engaged time on the items above, derived from the scope of work listed, and explicitly EXCLUDES the 10 and 30 minutes already filed. It is not a stopwatch measurement. The governor may substitute the actual figure and this entry should be amended if so.
  
  TDG derived by the dao_client rubric SSOT (rubric.py: Time (Minutes) = minutes / 60 * 100 = 90 / 60 * 100 = 150.00), not supplied by hand.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
